scope_statement: openBrowser interpolates an OAuth authorize URL, including the oauth_token query value, into child_process.exec shell text.

gate_rationale.identity_gate: Unreviewed GHSA-h2v8-4c3f-vqgv is unwithdrawn, aliases CVE-2025-12489, names evernote-mcp-server openBrowser command injection, and references first-party commit https://github.com/brentmid/evernote-mcp-server/commit/1e66c78c4ce6ea294ac6b0eb289a9eae9c5e9579. ZDI-25-983 and NVD bind the same commit. Clone origin is that repository. Empty affected[] is typical of unreviewed NVD import, not cross-binding. No github-reviewed collision.
gate_rationale.ai_hunk_gate: Atomic candidate e08547bc (n_parents=1, parent 9f7c1b36). Parent has no auth.js. Candidate adds auth.js with exec(`${command} "${url}"`). Marker: Generated with Claude Code plus Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>. git log -S openBrowser and -S exec( on auth.js both first hit this SHA. Not a megapatch sibling: the GHSA sink is this newly added hunk.
gate_rationale.topology_gate: Single parent 9f7c1b36. No squash and no carrier. Blame at fix parent still attributes the exec interpolation to e08547bc. Intermediate auth.js commits (4dd2d8c, 613ce9c, d3cb0b9, ae93a0a, b8444aa) do not rewrite the sink. Closer 1e66c78c is also Claude-marked and is the reversal, not origin.
gate_rationale.but_for_gate: Removing e08547bc removes auth.js, so openBrowser disappears. Concrete path: authenticate() -> getRequestToken() HTTPS querystring oauth_token -> redirectToAuthorization builds ${authorizeUrl}?oauth_token=${requestToken} with no encoding -> openBrowser(authUrl) -> exec(`${command} "${url}"`). First-party fix documents oauth_token="; touch /tmp/pwned #. CF4-b2 NARROW was not inherited; scoped to this hunk the megapatch is the origin, not a sibling.
gate_rationale.fix_reversal_gate: Exact closer 1e66c78c name-status is auth.js plus two tests. It switches child_process.exec interpolation to spawn(command, args) with the URL as an argv element. Direct reverse of this hunk.
